description: Templated explanations for pipeline stages, read by the API layer when the chat/LLM layer is unavailable (no hosted API key). These texts are static artifacts committed to the repository. They may not be edited to include hardcoded numeric claims.

ingest.title: Ingest stage
ingest.summary: The ingest stage fetches calibrated light curves from MAST and stellar parameters from Gaia DR3. When run from cache (offline mode), no network connection is required.
ingest.what_it_does: Downloads or reads from cache: (1) Kepler/TESS long- or short-cadence light curve FITS files via lightkurve, (2) Gaia DR3 stellar parameters (Teff, radius, RUWE) via astroquery.
ingest.what_it_does_not_do: The ingest stage does not assign any disposition to the target. It does not search for transits. It does not compute any probability score.

detrend.title: Detrend stage
detrend.summary: The detrend stage removes instrumental systematics from the raw light curve using the wotan biweight filter. Time-system metadata (TIMESYS, TIMEUNIT) from the FITS header is propagated unchanged.
detrend.what_it_does: Applies wotan biweight detrending to each light curve segment. Propagates time_scale and time_format without modification. Normalises flux to dimensionless relative flux.
detrend.what_it_does_not_do: The detrend stage does not identify transit signals. It does not assign any disposition.

search.title: Search stage
search.summary: The search stage runs transitleastsquares (TLS) on the detrended light curve to identify Threshold Crossing Events (TCEs). A TCE is a periodic dip consistent with a transit shape.
search.what_it_does: Runs TLS over the configured period grid. Returns all TCEs above the SNR threshold, sorted by SDE descending. An empty TCE list is a valid result for a quiet star.
search.what_it_does_not_do: The search stage does not assign any disposition to TCEs. It does not distinguish planets from eclipsing binaries.

vet.title: Vet stage
vet.summary: The vet stage applies seven named tests to each TCE and assigns a deterministic disposition. The disposition is computed exclusively from the test outcomes — no classifier is involved.
vet.what_it_does: Runs seven vetting tests: odd_even_depth, secondary_eclipse, centroid_shift, transit_shape, stellar_density, gaia_ruwe, systematics_coincidence. Disposition is one of: candidate, candidate_with_caveats, false_positive, ambiguous.
vet.what_it_does_not_do: The vet stage does not compute a probability score. It does not claim a planet detection. It does not screen for biosignatures.

classify.title: Classify stage
classify.summary: The classify stage applies a trained XGBoost model with isotonic calibration to produce a calibrated probability score for each TCE. This score is a ranking tool only.
classify.what_it_does: Extracts seven vetting-metric features from the VetOutput. Predicts a calibrated probability in [0, 1]. Estimates bootstrap uncertainty.
classify.what_it_does_not_do: The classifier does not assign a disposition. It does not override the vet stage result. A high probability does not constitute a detection claim. This is a ranking score, not a verdict.

non_claims: This project is not a biosignature detector.
No exoplanet biosignature has ever been confirmed.
The classifier probability is a ranking score only — not a verdict.
Disposition is determined exclusively by the vet stage.
The output of this pipeline is a triage list, not a detection claim.
